description: This file defines the implementation of the class `ec_pa_configurator_t` responsible for handling various DPP (Device Provisioning Protocol) and EasyMesh related message processing in a Proxy Agent context. It includes methods for handling presence announcements, reconfiguration, authentication, configuration requests and results, connection status, and processing encapsulated DPP messages, including fragmentation and GAS (Generic Advertisement Service) frames.

classes.name: ec_pa_configurator_t
classes.description: A class implementing handling of DPP and EasyMesh message processing for a Proxy Agent, including security setup, message parsing, fragmentation, and message forwarding according to the protocol specifications.

methods.name: bool handle_presence_announcement(ec_frame_t * frame,size_t len,uint8_t src_mac[ETHER_ADDR_LEN])
methods.description: Handles a presence announcement frame received via DPP, checking for matching bootstrap key hashes and sending notifications or authentication requests.

methods.name: bool handle_recfg_announcement(ec_frame_t * frame,size_t len,uint8_t sa[ETH_ALEN],uint8_t src_al_mac[ETH_ALEN])
methods.description: Handles a reconfiguration announcement frame, matching hashes and sending either an authentication request or an encap message to the controller.

methods.name: bool handle_auth_response(ec_frame_t * frame,size_t len,uint8_t src_mac[ETHER_ADDR_LEN],uint8_t src_al_mac[ETH_ALEN])
methods.description: Encapsulates and forwards a DPP authentication response frame to the controller.

methods.name: bool handle_cfg_request(uint8_t * buff,unsigned int len,uint8_t sa[ETH_ALEN])
methods.description: Handles a configuration request from an agent, encapsulating it into a 1905 message for the controller.

methods.name: bool handle_cfg_result(ec_frame_t * frame,size_t len,uint8_t sa[ETH_ALEN])
methods.description: Processes a configuration result from an agent, encapsulates it, and sends to the controller.

methods.name: bool handle_connection_status_result(ec_frame_t * frame,size_t len,uint8_t sa[ETH_ALEN])
methods.description: Processes a connection status result frame, encapsulates, and forwards it to the controller.

methods.name: bool process_proxy_encap_dpp_msg(em_encap_dpp_t * encap_tlv,uint16_t encap_tlv_len,em_dpp_chirp_value_t * chirp_tlv,uint16_t chirp_tlv_len,uint8_t src_al_mac[ETH_ALEN])
methods.description: Processes a proxied encapsulated DPP message, including parsing, fragmentation, handling specific frame types, and forwarding decision logic according to the protocol.

methods.name: bool process_direct_encap_dpp_msg(uint8_t * dpp_frame,uint16_t dpp_frame_len,uint8_t src_mac[ETH_ALEN])
methods.description: Handles direct encapsulated DPP messages received from the network, dispatching based on frame type.

methods.name: bool handle_gas_comeback_request(uint8_t * buff,unsigned int len,uint8_t sa[ETH_ALEN])
methods.description: Handles a GAS Comeback Request, sending the next fragment of a large message if available.

methods.name: bool send_prepare_for_fragmented_frames_frame(uint8_t dest_mac[ETH_ALEN])
methods.description: Sends a GAS Initial Response to prepare for fragmented frame transmission.

methods.name: std::vector<ec_gas_comeback_response_frame_t * > fragment_large_frame(const uint8_t * payload,size_t len,uint8_t dialog_token)
methods.description: Fragments a large payload into multiple GAS Comeback Response frames for transmission.
